bonus: **said** + that · **told me** · temps, pronoms et repères changent

illustration.prompt: a glossy violet speech bubble with a smaller golden speech bubble echoing behind it and a curved arrow, tiny golden sparkles, same art style as the reference icons, magenta background

marcel:
Il a dit que…
et tout recule !

blocs.regle: Verbe introducteur au **passé** (said, told) : chaque temps recule d’un cran. Au présent, rien ne change.

cartes.texte: now → **then** · today → **that day** · tomorrow → **the next day** · yesterday → **the day before** · here → **there**.
He **said** (that) he was tired. — He **told me** (that)… : tell veut une personne.
tell / ask + personne + **to** + base : She told me **to close** the door. / …**not to** be late.

oui.texte: He asked where **I lived**. / She asked **if I was** ready.

non.texte: She asked where did I live. / …if was I ready.

essai.texte: « Are you ready? » → He asked me ___ I was ready. → **if** (ou whether) !

etapes.texte: Verbe introducteur au passé → **recule**. Au présent → rien.
**if** / mot interrogatif + ordre affirmatif ; ordre → **to** + base.

blocs.donnees: « I **will** finish my project **tomorrow**, » said Emma.
blocs.calcul: will → would · I → she · my → her · tomorrow → the next day
blocs.resultat: [[Emma said she would finish her project the next day.]]

items: He told me to not shout → …**not to** shout
She asked me if was I ready → …if **I was** ready
